## Investment Recommendation

NVS (Novartis AG) is rated BUY with strong pipeline momentum. Revenue grew 7.2% YoY to $48.7B driven by Entresto, Cosentyx, and Kisqali. Operating margin of 29.4% reflects improved R&D productivity. DCF fair value: $125.00. Analyst price target: $118.00.

## Research & Development Pipeline

| Therapy Area | Phase III Assets | Peak Sales Est. |
|-------------|-----------------|----------------|
| Oncology | 5 assets | $12.5B |
| Cardiovascular | 3 assets | $8.2B |
| Neuroscience | 4 assets | $6.8B |
| Immunology | 2 assets | $4.1B |

## Key Risks

- Patent cliff on Entresto (2026 EU, 2027 US) creates $6B+ revenue at risk
- Pricing pressure from IRA Medicare negotiation provisions
- Clinical trial failures in early-stage pipeline

## Growth Opportunities

- Radiopharmaceutical platform (Pluvicto, AAA) targeting $15B+ addressable market
- Gene therapy expansion with Zolgensma lifecycle management
- Cardiovascular portfolio expansion beyond Entresto

Note: All figures in USD. Swiss franc exposure is hedged. Novartis maintains a 4.2% dividend yield and a BBB+ credit rating from S&P. The company’s focus on innovative medicines rather than generics (Sandoz spin-off completed) supports margin expansion over the medium term. Management’s guidance of mid-single-digit revenue CAGR through 2028 appears achievable given demographic tailwinds and emerging market expansion.
